domestic.debt_note: MTB auction 2026-08-20: govt raised Rs498bn vs a Rs500bn target (~Rs2.1tn total bids), cutoffs UP across every tenor vs the prior auction -- 1M 11.47% (+12bp), 3M 11.65% (+13bp), 6M 11.80% (+10bp), 12M 11.99% (+4bp) -- reconfirmed this run via https://tribune.com.pk/story/2624826/govt-raises-rs498b-via-t-bills-as-yields-rise. PIB 10Y remains anchored at the 2026-08-05 fixed-rate cutoff of 12.30% (3Y 11.745%, 5Y 11.80%, 15Y 12.485%, all up 16-26bp on that auction; 2Y bids rejected; Rs789bn raised vs Rs400bn target) -- no newer PIB auction found this run, sourced via https://profit.pakistantoday.com.pk/2026/08/05/govt-raises-rs789-billion-from-pibs-auction-as-yields-rise-across-tenors. The curve stays inverted above the held 11.5% policy rate and is still creeping wider -- a modest signal the market wants more compensation even as SBP holds -- a defensive carry cushion for T-bill/PIB-heavy bank books.
domestic.remittances: July 2026 (FY27 month 1) remittances $3.631bn, +13% YoY / +4.5%(some reports 5%) MoM -- Saudi Arabia $913.9mn, UAE $737.3mn, UK $555.5mn, US $317.2mn; FY26 closed at a record $41.6bn (+9% YoY vs $38.3bn FY25) -- reconfirmed this run via https://www.brecorder.com/news/40434250/jul-remittances-soar-13pc-to-usd36bn-yoy
domestic.current_account: July 2026 current account deficit $328mn, down 38% YoY (vs $529mn in July 2025) and down sharply from June 2026's $814mn deficit -- driven by goods exports rising 17% MoM/9% YoY to $3bn (19-month high) while imports held near $6.2bn; services trade deficit $228mn -- reconfirmed this run via https://www.brecorder.com/news/40435516/jul-ca-deficit-narrows-38pc-yoy. FY26 full year closed at a marginal $139mn deficit (0.03% of GDP).
